LanguageData.SE_NeuroplasticSerum.label: neuroplastic serum
LanguageData.SE_NeuroplasticSerum.description: A syringe of vivid magenta fluid containing mechanites that alter the brain's reward pathways. The user falls into a deep coma while these connections are rewritten, waking with a consuming passion for an activity that once held less interest. The new fascination is unpredictable. Knowledge and experience must still be earned.
LanguageData.SE_AdvancedNeuroplasticSerum.label: advanced neuroplastic serum
LanguageData.SE_AdvancedNeuroplasticSerum.description: A syringe of concentrated magenta fluid threaded with dark bioferrite. Unlike ordinary neuroplastic serum, its mechanites can be tuned to cultivate a particular interest. The treatment induces a prolonged coma while the brain's reward pathways are rebuilt around that activity, leaving a consuming passion without the knowledge or experience to match it.
